name: Shiny Days
source:
A remake of Summer Days with the addition of the new heroine Inori.

Setsuna starts doing part-time during the summer break at the popular seaside cafe Radish even though she isn’t used to being a waitress. It is because Makoto, who she secretly has feelings for, lives nearby and she might happen to meet him. Instead, she has a disastrous first meeting with Inori, who ends up rooming with her.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《Summer Days》的重制版，新增女主角足利祈。

暑假期间，不习惯服务生工作的清浦刹那仍来到人气海边咖啡厅Radish打工，因为她暗恋的伊藤诚住在附近，或许能偶然与他相遇。然而，她反而与足利祈有了一场灾难性的初次见面，后来还不得不和对方住在同一个房间。

[译自 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/04/01/april-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
